description: Source code for the main API server of a notes management application using FastAPI. Defines API endpoints for CRUD operations and search functionalities on notes, including app configuration, middleware, and route handlers.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Main application object for handling the API endpoints and middleware configuration.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint to check the health/status of the API server.

methods.name: list_notes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all notes sorted by most recent update.

methods.name: create_note(note: models.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new note based on provided data.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its unique ID.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note_update: models.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Updates an existing note by its ID with new data.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, returning success status.

methods.name: search_notes( query: str = Query(..., description="Query string to search for in notes' title or content"), skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db) )
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for notes by a query string in title or content.

ctags.name: list_notes
ctags.pattern: /^def list_notes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))

ctags.name: search_notes
ctags.signature: ( query: str = Query(..., description="Query string to search for in notes' title or content"), skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db) )

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, note_update: models.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(database.get/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, note_update: models.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db))
